verdict.rationale: pnpm's core value proposition is 'pnpm install' resolving and installing all declared dependencies from lockfile/manifest, with frozen-lockfile enforcement in CI ensuring reproducibility, content-addressable store hard-linking for speed, and drop-in npm compatibility (no migration needed). Community evidence corroborates fast, reliable installs in real projects and CI, including a 15s vs 35s speed comparison and large monorepo migrations working well out of the box. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark of a completely fresh clone-to-running-app walkthrough, and some community reports of edge-case install glitches (symlinks, peer deps) show minor friction.
